decisions.reason: Assigning the marketing site to get.drivereel.example preserves rather than changes the existing requirement that the root domain continue serving the customer-facing product.
The selected marketing-site hostname does not change the Basic Webflow plan or the cost-selection rule.
The marketing-site hostname does not change the dealer login button placement or its separate admin.drivereel.example destination.
Choosing get.drivereel.example for the marketing site does not change the contact-form recipient email addresses or lead-delivery behavior.
The custom subdomain decision does not alter the hero image, depicted controls, gallery, or mobile-phone presentation.
The marketing-site hostname does not change the requested Loom editing guide or its instructional purpose.
The domain selection does not change the requirement to transfer the Webflow website to the client's workspace.
The source establishes the site's hostname but does not change the early-access button's destination within the marketing site.
The selected subdomain does not change the landing page's content composition, image policy, or approved layout.
The marketing-site hostname does not change the required visual aesthetic, brand-asset usage, or Loom style reference.
